old_thin.state_note: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

decision_rationale: The overlay added mostly profitable trades and did not regress EV in the majority read, but the EV/PnL lift was too small to justify adding live capital or complexity. Keep Form 4 in forward observation instead of promoting it.

sample_officer_titles: EVP, CSO & Pres. LRL & LLY Imm

gate4.rule: EV first; material if EV >10%, Sharpe >0.1, DD -1pp, PnL >5%, or trade count rises with win rate not down

historical_experiment_check.exp-20260503-053: Owner-role filters were rejected; this run does not retune owner roles.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260504-006: Direct core-slot replacement evidence was too thin.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260504-009: Form 4 standalone sleeve was positive but not promoted because scarce-slot replacement was unanswered.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260504-032/033: SEC/earnings filing-shock family has no fresh evidence; this run avoids that blocked path.
historical_experiment_check.why_not_repeat: This is a portfolio-level overlay-capital test using the frozen queue, not another Form 4 threshold, role, accepted-trade overlap, or scarce-core-slot replacement test.

hypothesis: A bounded Form 4 meaningful-purchase event stream may improve portfolio-level expected value when added as a separate 10k-notional, one-position satellite overlay that does not consume core A/B slots.

llm_metrics.note: LLM existence is not treated as the problem; this run avoids LLM because ranking replay sample remains too sparse.

next_action: Continue accumulating forward Form 4 paper-sleeve outcomes; retry promotion only after larger closed sample or a higher-capacity event discriminator appears.
